name: Peninsula Pipeline Company System
monitor_reason: length: only a system aggregate (about 177 miles, seven Florida counties) is sourced. No source found that gives a length for any separate Peninsula segment of 25 km or more, other than the Callahan line, which is its own candidate.
researcher_notes: No existing GEM row for Peninsula Pipeline Company in the United States gas roster. The operator's own page, loaded and checked, says it has about 177 miles of intrastate transmission pipeline in seven Florida counties. That is a system total, not a per-project length. Searches of Florida Public Service Commission material, press and annual reports found no segment lengths that could be split into separate projects. The one segment with a sourced length is the Callahan Intrastate Pipeline, about 26.5 miles, built jointly with SeaCoast Gas Transmission, an affiliate of TECO Peoples Gas, and completed in 2020. A PR Newswire release and an Offshore Technology article, both loaded and checked, state this. It is already queued as its own candidate (callahan-intrastate-pipeline), so it is not staged here. The other roughly 150 miles have no sourced project-level lengths, so the length rule is not met. Chesapeake Utilities Corp matched the ownership-team list as an alias hit. Peninsula Pipeline Co had no close match and would be styled that way if a row is ever staged. The press also reports a new roughly 1.2 billion dollar Florida pipeline project from Chesapeake Utilities in July 2026. It was not researched here and may deserve its own candidate. Intrastate lines do not appear in FERC, so that silence is not an existence concern.
